package shapes_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	client "example.com/headershapes/gen/http/shapes/client"
	server "example.com/headershapes/gen/http/shapes/server"
	svc "example.com/headershapes/gen/shapes"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

type shapeService struct{}

func TestHeaderDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	for _, supplied := range []bool{false, true} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/defaults", nil)
		if supplied {
			req.Header.Set("X-Tags", "")
			req.Header.Set("X-Numbers", "")
		}
		got, err := server.DecodeDefaultsRequest(loomhttp.NewMuxer(), loomhttp.RequestDecoder)(req)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		want := &svc.Defaults{Tags: svc.Tags{"fallback"}, Numbers: []int{7}, Empty: []string{}}
		if supplied {
			want.Tags = svc.Tags{}
			want.Numbers = []int{}
		}
		require.Equal(t, want, got)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		result := &svc.Defaults{}
		if supplied {
			result.Tags = svc.Tags{}
			result.Numbers = []int{}
		}
		require.NoError(t, server.EncodeDefaultsResponse(loomhttp.ResponseEncoder)(context.Background(), response, result))
		decoded, err := client.DecodeDefaultsResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)(response.Result())
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, want, decoded)
		// Independently exercise client defaulting on an absent response field.
		if !supplied {
			empty := httptest.NewRecorder()
			empty.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			decoded, err = client.DecodeDefaultsResponse(loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)(empty.Result())
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, want, decoded)
		}
	}
}

func TestHeaderRequiredAndValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		tags    []string
		numbers []string
		valid   bool
	}{
		{"absent", nil, nil, false},
		{"present-empty", []string{""}, []string{"1"}, true},
		{"length-rejected", []string{""}, []string{""}, false},
		{"invalid-number", []string{"a"}, []string{"wrong"}, false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/required", nil)
			for _, value := range tc.tags {
				req.Header.Add("X-Tags", value)
			}
			for _, value := range tc.numbers {
				req.Header.Add("X-Numbers", value)
			}
			got, err := server.DecodeRequiredRequest(loomhttp.NewMuxer(), loomhttp.RequestDecoder)(req)
			if tc.valid {
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, svc.Tags{}, got.Tags)
			} else {
				require.Error(t, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHeaderViewsAndErrors(t *testing.T) {
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.NewEndpoints(shapeService{}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	t.Cleanup(host.Close)
	u, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	c := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	view, err := c.View()(context.Background(), nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, &svc.HeaderView{Tags: []string{"a", "b"}}, view)
	_, err = c.Fail()(context.Background(), nil)
	var failure *svc.Bad
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &failure)
	require.Equal(t, svc.Tags{"a", "b"}, failure.Tags)
	response := &httptest.ResponseRecorder{}
	err = server.EncodeDefaultsResponse(loomhttp.ResponseEncoder)(context.Background(), response, &svc.Defaults{Tags: svc.Tags{"private,comma"}})
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "private")
	require.Zero(t, response.Code)
	require.False(t, response.Flushed)
	require.Nil(t, response.Body)
	require.Empty(t, response.Header())
}

func (shapeService) Defaults(_ context.Context, value *svc.Defaults) (*svc.Defaults, error) {
	return value, nil
}

func (shapeService) Required(context.Context, *svc.RequiredPayload) error {
	return nil
}

func (shapeService) View(context.Context) (*svc.HeaderView, string, error) {
	return &svc.HeaderView{Tags: []string{"a", "b"}}, "tiny", nil
}

func (shapeService) Fail(context.Context) error {
	return &svc.Bad{Tags: svc.Tags{"a", "b"}}
}
